mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participation (learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at) VALUES (#{learnerEnrollmentId}, #{status}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{trainingTime}, #{participationDate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE participation_date = #{participationDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY participation_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM learner_enrollment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND participation_date = #{participationDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE participation SET status = #{status}, check_in = #{checkIn}, check_out = #{checkOut}, training_time = #{trainingTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM course c JOIN learner_enrollment le ON c.id = le.course_id WHERE c.is_in_progress = 1 AND le.completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(training_time), 0) FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM learner_enrollment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
